fields.help: JSON array of {current_key, new_key}. Dot paths rename nested keys (a.b.c). Applied in order before the regex replacements.
fields.label: Keys (JSON)

fields.help: JSON array of {search_regex, replace_regex, case_insensitive, depth}. Renames every key matching search_regex (first match per key); $1 refers to a capture group. depth -1 = all levels, 0 = top level only.
fields.label: Regex Replacements (JSON)

outputs.description: the input item's fields, with the configured keys renamed
each renamed key, holding the value of its current_key
